abilities.name: Assimilation
abilities.description: Gain 20% of damage dealt from Basic Attacks and 10% from Abilities as Shields for 6 seconds. Shield amount gained doubled against Heroes. Yellowtext Current maximum: 1004; trait

fields.notes: Benefits from all damage from Basic and Heroic Abilities and Talents. Duration is refreshed every time more Shields are gained through Assimilation. Shields gained are calculated from the final damage dealt after all damage modifiers. Hero bonus stacks multiplicatively with all bonuses from talents affecting Assimilation 's baseline Shield gain.

abilities.name: Ravage
abilities.description: Charge CooldownW 8 / 0.25 Leap at a target, dealing 115 damage. If the enemy dies within 1.5 seconds, restore 1 charge and refund 20 Mana. Quest Kill enemies within 1.5 seconds of being hit by Ravage. Minions grant 1 stack and Heroes grant 7 stacks. After reaching 85 stacks, Ravage gains 125 additional damage. Reward After reaching 150 stacks, Ravage deals a further 200 additional damage.

abilities.name: Impaling Blades
abilities.description: After 1.25 seconds, deal 140 damage to enemies within the target area, Stunning them for 0.75 seconds.

abilities.name: Primal Grasp
abilities.description: Pulls enemies within the target area towards Kerrigan, dealing 40 damage. After 2.5 seconds, an explosion occurs around Kerrigan, dealing 165 damage to nearby enemies.

fields.notes: Both pull and explosion trigger talents affecting Primal Grasp . Removes active knockbacks on hit.

abilities.name: Maelstrom
abilities.description: Deals 74 damage per second to nearby enemies. Lasts for 7 seconds.; 90; 80; heroic

fields.notes: Kerrigan can't mount while Maelstrom is active.

abilities.name: Summon Ultralisk
abilities.description: After 0.5 seconds, summon an Ultralisk that rushes foward upon spawning, dealing 250 damage to the first enemy Hero hit and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds. The Ultralisk's Basic Attacks deal 50% of their damage in an area around their target. Reactivate to retarget the Ultralisk. Ultralisk Charge ; 80; 75; heroic

fields.type: Spell Damage, Crowd control / Movement: Dash
fields.notes: Upon summon, Ultralisk spawns in front of Kerrigan and casts Charge to the target direction. Kerrigan gains Assimilation Shields from all damage dealt by Ultralisk.

talents.name: Psionic Barrier
talents.description: Each enemy Hero hit by Primal Grasp grants 20 Spell Armor and 4% Movement Speed for 4 seconds, stacking up to 20% Movement Speed.

fields.notes: Armor stacks up to 10 times (cannot bypass the Armor cap of 75 after subtracting the largest Armor debuff active on Kerrigan). Both effects stack additively with themselves, but not with other positive Spell Armor or Movement Speed effects. Consecutive applications refresh the duration of existing stacks.

talents.description: Cooldown 90 Activate to place Kerrigan in a Chrysalis with 650 Health for 5 seconds. While inside, Kerrigan regenerates 4% of her maximum Health per second. Enemies can destroy the Chrysalis to end its effects early. Chrysalis

fields.notes: Chrysalis can be reactivated after 0.5 seconds to end its effect early. Chrysalis places Kerrigan in Stasis, removing most negative effects from her.

fields.notes: Spell Power increase applies after the damage from Ravage is dealt. Consecutive applications refresh the duration of existing stacks.
